trimmed_dict.title: An Evening with Moradok Mai: Thai Arts, Culture, and "Thom: A Life Already Written"
trimmed_dict.date: Tuesday, April 21, 2026 8pm to 9:30pm
trimmed_dict.description:
Immerse yourself with Thai music, theatre, dance, and history through live performances by teachers and students from Moradok Mai Home School, as well as Thai language students and Thai students on campus. Moradok Mai Home School is an alternative learning Community in Thailand that integrates arts, culture, and holistic education. In addition to a Thai fusion music concert, Moradok Mai will present Thom: A Life Already Written, a story of a young man’s struggle between fate and choice, and his desire to escape a life already defined for him. Through music and storytelling, the performance reflects on identity, expectation, and what one leaves behind.We invite you to celebrate Thai culture by wearing Thai attire - anything from a shawl, or elephant pants to a silk sarong. Light refreshments will be served at 7:30 p.m.
 
Sponsored by the World Language Program, the Center for International Studies, the Chaddock + Morrow College of Fine Arts, and the Thai Student Association
